# Gurudatta Trading Co.

> Spring manufacturer in Goregaon East, Mumbai, India, operating since 1995. Makes compression, extension and torsion springs, die springs, spiral springs and wire forms to a customer's drawing or sample, and supplies circlips, pins, hooks and mechanical seals. Dispatch across India and export.

This file summarises https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/ for AI assistants. Links point to the canonical page for each topic. A longer plain-text version with every product is at [llms-full.txt](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/llms-full.txt).

## Business facts
- Business name: Gurudatta Trading Co.
- Founded: 1995 (30+ years in operation)
- Address: Amin Compound, Sonawala Cross Rd No. 2, Opp. Pride House, Sonawala Industry Estate, Goregaon East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400063, India
- Hours: open 24 hours (Monday to Saturday)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 84549 95315
- Email: connect.gtc5@gmail.com
- Business type: direct manufacturer (not a trading middleman)
- Products: compression, extension and torsion springs, die springs, spiral springs, wire forms, circlips, dowel and steel pins, steel hooks, mechanical shaft seals
- Materials: mild steel, stainless steel, music wire, other alloys on request
- Catalogue: 17 categories, 93 products
- Order size: single prototype springs up to bulk industrial orders; no fixed minimum order quantity
- Quote response: within 24 hours by WhatsApp, email or phone
- Delivery: PAN India and export (IEC registered)
- Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015, GST registered (GSTIN 27CBBPG9951J1ZB), IEC, Udyam (MSME), IndiaMART TrustSeal verified, TradeIndia Certificate of Trust
- Customer reviews: listed on the Reviews page

## What we make
- [Steel Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/steel-spring/): 14 products. Steel springs for industrial and engineering use — compression, extension and torsion designs in mild steel and stainless steel, supplied from stock or made to your drawing.
- [Industrial Springs](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/industrial-springs/): 16 products. Industrial springs for machinery, automotive, fabrication and OEM applications, in compression, extension, torsion and specialty forms.
- [Steel Hook](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/steel-hook/): 7 products. Steel hooks and S-hooks in mild steel and stainless steel for hanging, fastening, tensioning and general fabrication use.
- [Circlips](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/circlips/): 5 products. Circlips and snap rings that retain components on shafts and inside bores, in standard and stainless steel variants.
- [Dowel Pin](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/dowel-pin/): 5 products. Dowel pins for accurate alignment and location of machine parts, tooling and assemblies.
- [Wire Form](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/wire-form/): 6 products. Wire forms and custom-bent wire components made to your sample or drawing.
- [Coil Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/coil-spring/): 3 products. Coil springs for cushioning, suspension and load-bearing uses, made in a range of wire sizes and materials.
- [Mechanical Shaft Seals](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/mechanical-shaft-seals/): 3 products. Mechanical shaft seals and sealing components that help prevent leakage along rotating shafts in pumps and machinery.
- [Compression Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/compression-spring/): 9 products. Compression springs resist a pushing force and return to their original length — used in valves, machinery, mattresses and cushioning.
- [Torsion Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/torsion-spring/): 6 products. Torsion springs store and release rotational force — used in hinges, clips and lever mechanisms.
- [Steel Pin](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/steel-pin/): 2 products. Steel pins for fastening, locating and pivot uses in assemblies.
- [R Pin](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/r-pin/): 5 products. R-pins (R-clips) are quick-fit retaining pins used to secure shafts, pins and fittings.
- [Locking Items](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/locking-items/): 3 products. Locking items and retaining hardware that keep assemblies secure.
- [Spring Seal](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/spring-seal/): 1 product. Spring-energised seals that maintain sealing contact under pressure.
- [Die Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/die-spring/): 3 products. Die springs are heavy-duty rectangular-wire compression springs used in tooling, dies, moulds and press applications.
- [Spiral Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/spiral-spring/): 4 products. Spiral (clock-type) flat springs that release stored energy gradually — used in timers, clocks and retractable mechanisms.
- [Tension Spring](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/products/tension-spring/): 1 product. Tension (extension) springs resist a pulling force and pull back to their original length — used in trampolines, garage doors and trigger mechanisms.

## Guides
- [Spring Wire Gauge (SWG) Chart: SWG to mm and inch](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/spring-wire-gauge-swg-chart.html): Standard Wire Gauge (SWG) chart for spring wire: SWG 8 to 30 converted to millimetres and inches, with how to pick a wire diameter for springs.
- [Compression Spring Rate Formula with Worked Example](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/spring-rate-formula-compression-spring.html): How to calculate compression spring rate: k = G·d⁴ / (8·D³·N). Worked example, spring index and solid height, plus a free online calculator.
- [How to Measure a Spring (Wire Diameter, OD, Free Length, Coils)](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/how-to-measure-a-spring.html): Step-by-step guide to measure a compression, extension or torsion spring: wire diameter, outer diameter, free length, coil count, ends and winding direction.
- [Mild Steel vs Stainless Steel vs Music Wire Springs](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/mild-steel-vs-stainless-steel-vs-music-wire-springs.html): Compare mild steel, stainless steel and music wire springs: corrosion resistance, cost, strength and typical uses, with tips to choose the right material.
- [Custom Spring Cost in India: Price Factors and Quote Checklist](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/custom-spring-cost-and-quote-checklist.html): What drives the price of custom springs in India: material, wire size, quantity, tolerances, finishing, plus a checklist of details to send for a fast quote.
- [Extension Spring Formula: Load, Rate & Extension (Example)](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/extension-spring-load-formula.html): Extension spring formula: load F = F0 + k·x, so extension x = (F − F0) / k. Worked example, initial tension explained, plus a free spring calculator.
- [Torsion Spring Torque Formula & Rate (Worked Example)](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/torsion-spring-torque-formula.html): Torsion spring torque formula and rate: k = E·d⁴ / (64·D·N) per radian. Worked example, leg and winding notes, and a free calculator.
- [Spring End Types Explained: Closed, Ground, Open](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/spring-end-types-explained.html): Compare compression spring end types (open, closed, closed and ground) and extension/torsion spring ends, and how ends change active coils and solid height.
- [Spring Finishes and Coatings: Zinc, Black Oxide, Powder Coat](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/spring-finishes-and-coatings.html): Guide to spring finishes: zinc plating, black oxide, powder coating, oiling and stainless passivation — what each protects against and when to choose it.
- [IS 4454 Spring Wire Standard: Part 1, 2 & 4 Explained](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/is-4454-spring-wire-grades-explained.html): IS 4454 explained: Part 1 grades SL, SM, SH, DM, DH with wire-diameter ranges, Part 2 (oil hardened & tempered), Part 3 history and Part 4 (stainless).
- [Die Spring Colour Code Chart: Light to Extra-Heavy Duty](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/die-spring-colour-code-chart.html): How die spring colour coding works (ISO 10243 style): four duty levels, light to extra-heavy, and why the colour-to-duty mapping can vary by manufacturer.
- [Trampoline Spring Buying Guide: Size, Count & Replacement](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/trampoline-spring-buying-guide.html): How to choose replacement trampoline springs: measuring length and hook type, matching spring count to your trampoline, and signs it is time to replace them.
- [Compression Spring: Types, Terms, Formulas & Design Guide](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/guides/compression-springs-complete-guide.html): What a compression spring is and how it works: types, key terms, the rate formula with an example, materials, design rules and common failures.

## Frequently asked questions
- **Where is Gurudatta Trading Co. located?** At Amin Compound, Sonawala Cross Rd No. 2, Sonawala Industry Estate, Goregaon East, Mumbai 400063. Springs are made at this Mumbai factory and dispatched across India.
- **What does Gurudatta Trading Co. make?** Compression, extension and torsion springs, die springs, spiral springs and wire forms, plus circlips, dowel and steel pins, steel hooks and mechanical shaft seals, in mild steel, stainless steel and music wire.
- **Can springs be made to my drawing or sample?** Yes. Send a drawing, a sample spring or the working parameters (wire diameter, outer diameter, free length, number of coils, load) on WhatsApp or email.
- **Is there a minimum order quantity?** No fixed minimum. Orders range from a single prototype spring to bulk industrial quantities.
- **How quickly is a quotation provided?** Within 24 hours by WhatsApp, email or phone.
- **Which areas of Maharashtra do you supply?** Mumbai, Bhiwandi, Taloja and Thane, Vasai-Virar and Palghar, Raigad, Pune, Nashik, Solapur, Satara, Sangli and Karad, Kolhapur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and Nagpur, all dispatched from the Mumbai factory. Each area has its own page listed below.
- **Do you deliver outside Maharashtra or export?** Yes. Dispatch is PAN India, and the company holds an Import Export Code (IEC) for export orders.
- **How can I calculate spring rate before ordering?** Use the free Spring Calculator, which returns spring rate, safe load, deflection, solid height and stress for compression, extension and torsion springs. No signup is needed to read the guides.
